 afk Dashboard                                                                                                          
  ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮  
  │ Sessio╭─ actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ojects │  
  │       │ type an action's name                                                                            │       │  
  │ ╭─────│                                                                                                  │─────╮ │  
  │ │ 1 Se│ go in                               enter      — Go in a level, or open what is selected         │     │ │  
  │ │  ▾ N│ go back                             esc        — Go back a level, or close what is open          │     │ │  
  │ │ ▌ ◐ │ jump                                /          — Jump to another project                         │     │ │  
  │ │   ◐ │ inbox                               i          — the inbox has not been read yet                 │     │ │  
  │ │   ✕ │ details                             d          — Show the selected session's details             │     │ │  
  │ │  ▾ W│ read usage                          R          — this dashboard cannot read usage                │     │ │  
  │ │   ◐ │ keys                                ?          — Show every key, level by level                  │     │ │  
  │ │   ◐ │ quit                                q          — Leave the dashboard; every session keeps runni… │     │ │  
  │ │  ▾ D│ start a new plan                               — starting a plan is not available here           │     │ │  
  │ │   ✓ │ add a project                       +          — works on All projects                           │     │ │  
  │ │     │ remove the project                  -          — works on All projects                           │     │ │  
  │ │     │ answer the oldest                   a          — works on All projects                           │     │ │  
  │ │     │ pause or resume the build           p          — this project has no build                       │     │ │  
  │ │     │ new session                         n          — Start a new session from a plan or a branch     │     │ │  
  │ │     │ one-off session                     o          — Start a one-off session with no plan            │     │ │  
  │ │     │ clean session                       c          — Clean the selected session and its worktree     │     │ │  
  │ │     │ restart agent                       r          — only a stopped or stuck agent can be restarted  │     │ │  
  │ │     │ edit label                          l          — Give the selected session a display label       │     │ │  
  │ │     │ next section                        tab        — Move to the next section: Sessions, Build, Inb… │     │ │  
  │ │     │ previous section                    shift+tab  — Move to the previous section                    │     │ │  
  │ │     │ sessions section                    1          — Move to the Sessions section                    │     │ │  
  │ │     │ build section                       2          — Move to the Build section, the plan's tasks     │     │ │  
  │ │     │ inbox section                       3          — Move to the Inbox section, the open items       │     │ │  
  │ ╰─────│ set this task's status              s          — this dashboard cannot change the ledger         │     │ │  
  │ ╭─────│ show this task's tokens             t          — this dashboard cannot read the token ledger     │     │ │  
  │ │ feat│ mouse                               m          — works in the agent, after ctrl+]                │     │ │  
  │ │─────│ extend the plan                                — Start a planning session that adds work to the… │     │ │  
  │ │ bran│ amend the plan                                 — Change the plan; asks what to change in a sent… │─────╯ │  
  │ │ phas│ fix a bug                                      — Find and fix a bug; asks what is broken         │─────╮ │  
  │ │ diff│ reconcile the plan with a document             — Fit the plan to a document; asks for its path   │     │ │  
  │ │ host│ check the plan                                 — checking the plan is not available here         │     │ │  
  │ ╰─────│ approve the plan                               — approving is not available here                 │─────╯ │  
  │  tab/1╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── type to search · enter runs · esc closes ─╯       │  
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯  
enter run · ↑/↓ move · type filter · esc close · ctrl+c quit
